{{Quote|You who have no family, come to join the family of Niya-Ton, who birthed Zhi-Ton under the Prophecy of Ten Thousand Seeds.|Phi-Ton|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Zhi-Ton''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] living on [[Voss]] centuries before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was the son of [[Niya-Ton]] and the distant predecessor of [[Therod-Ton]], [[Bas-Ton]], [[Phi-Ton]] and [[Yana-Ton]].
